Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites application on plain paper enclosed with the self-certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience for the
temporary
post of
Lower Division Clerk
which must reach to the Principal, Kasturba Nursing College, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
30/10/2021
.
Designation
Total Post
Category
Qualification & Experience
Lower Division Clerk
01
---
Graduate from a recognized University, proficiency in operating computers, MSCIT, Typing 40 WPM English, Typing 30 WPM Marathi/Hindi.
One Year Experience.
Note:
Age limit for reserved candidate 18 to 43 , for Open candidates 18 to 38
Suitable & experienced candidate can be considered for relaxation in age & experience.
Decision of selection committee will be final
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
